m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Hello, young Wizard. What brings you to this place of ashes and ruin?
The whereabouts of the Hoarder? Oh, do not ask me that... I would feel terrible if something happened to you!
If you absolutely must know, the Hoarder dwells in the Plaza of Conquests, in a tower full of stolen magic.
The Hoarder's origins are a mystery... it steals magic and serves Morganthe, but to what end?
It is the way of things that you must defeat the Hoarder if you wish to get magic from it. I wish you victory in this task.
You recovered the missing spell? I expected no less!
At this point, I would provide you with a copy of the spell for your use, but I am afraid that I cannot.
Wizard City has been victimized by one of Morganthe's servants, a diabolical thief of spells known as the Hoarder.
Many spells were taken from our library, and among them the one I was planning to teach you!
Those spells must be recovered! Venture, if you can, to Dragonspyre, where you must speak with Milos Bookwyrm in the Atheneum.
Milos can put you on the path of the Hoarder, so you can recover this stolen spell.
If you wish to recover the Gnomes! spell, travel to Dragonspyre after the Hoarder. Speak to Milos Bookwyrm in the Atheneum.
